items.name: 星河
items.theme: Theme: GALAXY / 星河. Deep midnight indigo and near-black navy satin interior. Elegant luminous violet-blue nebula filaments flow just along the bottom rim, tiny icy star glints confined to edge corners, delicate silver-metal edge with subtle iridescent blue. A small luminous cosmic eddy hugs the far-right mid-edge. Celestial, sophisticated and vivid at edges, with expansive dark calm inside. Avoid densely scattered stars across text zones.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium cosmetic player nameplate BACKGROUND for a Unity poker game's shop and horizontal player list.
Create ONE finished, original raster UI background asset, front-facing flat orthographic, a wide rounded rectangle with aspect ratio 8:3. Canvas 1536 by 576 pixels. The rounded rectangle should nearly fill the canvas, with only 8 pixels of exterior padding. Rounded corners about 55 pixels radius. Opaque very dark interior; genuinely transparent exterior corner pixels. Refined detailed game artwork, tactile materials, controlled bloom, crisp premium finish.
Composition and readability: upper left is for a player's name, lower left for their balance, upper right for the countdown, lower middle for role/status badges. These zones must remain dark and quiet. Keep the central 75 percent low contrast and uncluttered. Concentrate visual interest around the outer rim, the upper/lower edges, and a small accent on the far right midway vertically. Decorations must still read when reduced to a 280 by 104 pixel card. Restrained slim frame, never an enormous ornamental border.
Text: absolutely none. No names, letters, numbers, price tags, logos, watermark, suits, poker cards, buttons, UI labels or status icons. No perspective, physical card mockup, scene, tabletop, drop shadow on backdrop, grid, contact sheet or extra cards. Only one reusable background texture. No painted checkerboard.

items.name: 赤焰
items.theme: Theme: EMBER / 赤焰. Obsidian dark charcoal plate with subtle cooled volcanic texture, blackened red metal edge. Vivid molten orange-red fissures and curling embers trace the lower rim and right mid-edge, giving the impression of banked fire contained in black metal. Fine warm metal highlights at corners. Hot heroic energy at the edge, cool dark spacious interior, no wall of flames and no texture noise behind the name or balance.

items.name: 霓虹
items.theme: Theme: NEON / 霓虹. Deep black-teal glass-metal panel, clean elegant futuristic construction. Slim cyan light traces on upper and left edges transition to magenta-violet along lower and right edges, a few crisp offset parallel light trails and faceted corner details. Small angular neon flourish at the far-right mid-edge. Premium cyberpunk visual energy, restrained bloom, empty dark center. Not a busy circuit board, avoid lines resembling controls and avoid luminous central geometry.

items.name: 鎏金
items.theme: Theme: GILDED / 鎏金. Very dark emerald-black lacquer with subtle brushed fine grain. Luxurious warm antique-gold filigree and thin metallic inlays anchored in the corners, an elegant small flowing gold flourish at the far-right mid-edge, soft gold-dust accents along the lower rim. Sophisticated casino luxury, polished gold and deep jade, richer ornament than the other cards but clean quiet center. Gold is ornamental with intentional gaps, not one uniform bright yellow active-player outline. No crown, crest, badge or symbol.
